name: Acquire.com

sources.title: Sell your business — 3-step seller flow, 'Join now' goes to app.acquire.com/signup
Seller pricing — monthly listing fee plus 6-8% closing fee scaled by asking price

requirements: This is a marketplace for SELLING an operating business, not a product-launch directory — only usable when the project itself is being sold
Seller listing flow: describe the business, explain why you're selling, and sync your metrics (web, customer, and financial data connections)
'Guided by Acquire' advisory tier is restricted to profitable SaaS startups with $100k+ revenue
preparation: Business financials and metrics ready to sync (analytics, revenue, customer metrics integrations)
Asking price and reason for selling
Listing copy: business description, growth details, assets included
Budget for the monthly listing fee ($25/mo under $250k asking, $50/mo for $250k-$1M, $100/mo above $1M) plus 6-8% closing fee if it sells
workflow: Go to https://acquire.com/sellers and click 'Join now' (leads to app.acquire.com/signup)
Create a seller account, then 'List Your Startup' — enter basic details, describe the business, explain why you're selling
Sync web, customer, and financial metrics so buyers see verified data
Pay the monthly listing fee to publish; work with the assigned customer-success/expert advisor to optimize the listing
Field vetted buyers, negotiate, and close via the included escrow (Escrow.com) — the 6-8% closing fee is due only on sale
watchFor: Not a free backlink route: listing costs $25-$100/month while live, plus a 6-8% closing fee on a completed sale
Only appropriate for a real exit — do not list a product just for exposure
Site requires JavaScript; app flows live on app.acquire.com
Automated NDAs and identity/funds vetting protect sellers — expect buyers to request verified metrics
countsAsLive: The business listing is published on Acquire.com and visible to its buyer base (browsable under the 'Online businesses for sale' categories)
unknowns: Minimum eligibility thresholds for the standard (non-Guided) seller listing
Whether listings are publicly indexable or gated behind buyer accounts
